title: Rules file (data/rules/<id>.json, one set of rules per file)
description: The numbers a system runs on, so tuning needs no code (GDD §6). The file's id says which rules it holds. Known ids: 'time' (the day's clock, read by DayClock), 'energy' (the hero's energy, read by EnergyRules), 'hours' (when places are open and villagers are out, read by Hours), 'night' (what the night does to monsters, read by NightRules), 'farm' (the hero's plot, read by Farm), 'skills' (the hero's skills, read by Skills), 'friendship' (what talk and gifts are worth, read by Friendship), 'mine' (the Old Quarry, read by MineRules), 'crafting' (the furnace, the chest and the home's furnishings, checked by Crafting) 'homestead' (which map is the hero's land and the rocks that stand on it, read by HomesteadRules), 'dungeon' (what each dungeon does to the monsters in it, read by DungeonRules) and 'ground_detail' (the small still details drawn on the ground, read by GroundDetails).

day_ends.description: When the day runs out. A time before day_starts is in the small hours of the next morning.

seconds_per_hour.description: Real seconds one hour of the day takes.

lamps_lit.description: When lamps are lit. May run over midnight.

night.description: When it is night. May run over midnight.

light.description: The colour of the light outdoors at times of the day, in order from the day's start to its end. Between two times the light is between their colours.

color.description: Red, green and blue, each 0 to 1. Everything outdoors is multiplied by it: [1, 1, 1] is clear daylight.

costs.description: What things cost. Anything not named here is free.

hoe.description: Tilling a cell of the plot with the hoe.

water.description: Watering a cell of the plot with the can.

mine.description: A blow of the pickaxe on a rock.

chop.description: A blow of the axe on a branch, a stump or a log (no skill eases it).

below.description: Under this energy the hero is tired.

move.description: The share of his speed he keeps when tired.

cooldown.description: What the sword's cooldown is multiplied by when tired.

no_sprint_below.description: Under this energy he can't sprint.

collapse.description: What running out of energy (or staying up until the day ends) costs.

wake_share.description: The share of a full bar he wakes with.

coins_lost_share.description: The share of his coins he loses, rounded down.

coins_lost_most.description: The most coins he can lose.

places.description: A place's id (an AreaExit's `hours`), then when its door is open. May run over midnight. A place whose hours begin and end together is never open: the old cottage in Hearthvale ('old_cottage', 00:00 to 00:00), locked since the Homestead.

shut.description: What is said at the door when it is shut.

outdoors.description: When villagers who stand outdoors are out; the rest of the day they have gone home.

then.description: What a monster met outdoors at night (the 'night' span of the time rules) is multiplied by. 1 leaves it as by day.

coin_drops.description: The weight of each coin drop in its table.

places.description: Each place (a dungeon's id, or an area's id for a place with no dungeon id, as the quarry's floors) and what a monster there is multiplied by. A place not named is left as in the fields; bosses and monsters only there by night are never changed. A number left out is 1.

damage.description: Its touch and its arrows. Rounded up.

hearts.description: The weight of each heart drop in its table.

plot.description: The size of the hero's plot in cells: the field on the homestead, 12 by 6 (6 by 3 until the Homestead; a saved plot's cells are its north-west corner). Where it lies is the FarmPlot node's position in its area.

wither_after.description: How many dry mornings in a row wither a crop.

levels.description: The points each level begins at, rising, the first of them 0.

step.description: The share each level above the first takes off a cost a skill eases, or adds to a dish. Times the levels above the first it must stay under 1.

skills.description: The hero's skills by id, in the order the pause menu lists them.

gains.description: The points each deed gives. The game reports: monster, boss, till, harvest, dish, rock, ore.

eases.description: The energy costs (the energy rules' names) each level makes cheaper.

enriches_dishes.description: Each level makes a cooked dish give more energy.

extra_chance.description: Each level above the first adds this to the chance that the work gives one more of what it gives (Mining: a rock of ore leaves one more). No more than 1 at the top level.

hall.description: The area the mine is entered through: where the lift stands, and where a fall ends.

floors.description: The floors from the top down. The last has no ladder down.

area.description: The floor's area id. Its rocks are the 'rock' markers of its map.

ores.description: How many of the floor's rocks hold each kind of ore today (a kind in 'rocks', never 'stone'). The rest are plain stone, and one of those hides the ladder.

lift.description: The floors (numbered from 1) the lift reaches once the hero has come to them on foot.

rocks.description: Every kind of rock, 'stone' (a plain rock) among them.

blows.description: The blows of the plain pickaxe it takes.

gives.description: The item it leaves (one of it) when it breaks.

marks.description: How many marks a full friendship is.

points_per_mark.description: The points that make one mark.

talk.description: The points for the first talk with a villager in a day.

liked_gift.description: The points for a gift the villager likes. At least other_gift.

other_gift.description: The points for any other gift.

gift_types.description: The item types that can be given (types that items in data/items have).

friend_marks.description: The marks at which a villager counts as a friend on the ending screen. At most marks; left out, only a full friendship counts.

furnace_most.description: The most the furnace makes in one load (so many bars a night).

chest_slots.description: How many stacks the storage chest holds, each up to its item's own max_stack.

furnishings.description: What the hero's home can be furnished with: the names a crafting recipe's 'makes' may give as its 'furnishing'. Each is a Furnishing node of that id in the home's scene, and the flag home/<name> once it is made.

area.description: The map that is the hero's land (an area's id). What is cleared there is cleared for good, and nowhere else.

rocks.description: The kinds of rock that stand on the land (read by HomesteadRules). 'rock' is the plain one, grown from the map's rock markers; any other kind is a spawn marker of its own name (GreyboxTiles.ROCK_MARKERS) and a frame of gameplay/art/rocks.png.

blows.description: The blows it is counted at for the plain pickaxe. A better pickaxe takes its 'fewer_blows' off that: a boulder of 4 is 3 blows of the Copper Pickaxe and 2 of the Iron.

wants.description: The least pickaxe that breaks it (an item id). A pickaxe that needs more blows than that one is told "It wants a better pickaxe." and spends nothing. Left out, any pickaxe breaks it.

gives.description: The item it leaves lying in its cell.

places.description: The kinds of area that have details (Ambience: outdoors; a house or a farm building's room; a dungeon, the quarry among them).

grounds.description: For each kind of ground (GroundDetails.ground_of: grass at heights 0 to 2, the path, the dungeon floor, the ledge, the quarry's earth, the marsh), how many of its open cells get a detail and which. A cell is open when it holds nothing, nothing holds the cell below it, and its four neighbours look as it does. Which cell gets which is a fixed hash of the cell.

chance.description: The share of open cells that get a detail: 0.25 is one in four. The one number to tune.

details.description: A frame of world/tiles/ground_details.png (GroundDetails.FRAMES), then its weight: a detail of weight 2 is chosen twice as often as one of weight 1.

drifts.description: Details gathered in squares: 'share' of the squares of 'size' by 'size' cells are a drift of one of 'details' (chosen by the square), where an open cell gets it at 'chance' in place of the ground's own.

unmirrored.description: Details never drawn mirrored (lit from one side). The others are mirrored half the time, by the cell.

$comment: One entry of allOf for each id: time, energy, hours, night, farm, skills, mine, friendship, crafting, homestead, ground_detail.

time_of_day.description: A time on a 24-hour clock, like "06:00".
